note: Cherokee County KS (FIPS 20021) publishes no queryable zoning district polygon service that I could find. The county's GIS (integritygis parcel viewer) is parcel-focused and its service endpoints did not respond. Galena publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (Aug 2023). Columbus abolished its planning commission per its ordinance list. Baxter Springs showed no zoning GIS. Only third-party commercial parcel data (Regrid, Dynamo Spatial, Rockford Map) carries zoning fields.
